set.o: Roark Capital Group (brand owner); McWin Restaurant Fund (French master franchisee)
set.note: US private equity firm Roark Capital bought Subway from the founding families in 2024 (deal agreed August 2023, about $9.6bn). why: Owner text missed the 2024 change of French operator: McWin Restaurant Fund (PE) took the France/Belgium/Luxembourg master franchise and bought Subway France in 2024.

set.o: Five Guys Europe — Sir Charles Dunstone's investment vehicle Freston Ventures (bought the Murrell family's 50% in 2025)
set.note: Five Guys' French restaurants are company-run by Five Guys Europe, until 2025 a 50/50 joint venture between the US founding Murrell family and Freston Ventures, the investment vehicle of Carphone Warehouse co-founder Sir Charles Dunstone. In November 2025 Dunstone agreed to buy the Murrells' half (the European arm now pays a royalty to the US brand owner) and hired Goldman Sachs to sell up to 50% to new investors, with buyout firms circling.

why: French restaurants are not owned by Five Guys Enterprises but by the Five Guys Europe JV with Charles Dunstone's Freston Ventures, which agreed to buy out the Murrells in 2025 and is selling up to half to investors; investment-vehicle control -> pe per project convention.

set.o: Wagram Food Service — Financière de l'Intendance (Paillaud family office, majority); CEO Nicolas Riché, Bpifrance FIT3 & Eram (minority)
set.note: Run by Wagram Food Service, whose majority shareholder is Financière de l'Intendance, a family office linked to the Paillaud family; CEO Nicolas Riché keeps a minority stake. why: Wagram is not controlled by Nicolas Riché: majority is held by the Paillaud family office Financière de l'Intendance, Riché is a minority holder.
